_note: Every region the forecast can cover. Each one is a separate daily run and
its own folder under docs/data/, so the page can switch between them.
COVERAGE IS NOT UNIFORM, and the app says so per region:
species_file  a validated species pack, or null. The pack in this repo
is Adriatic and its legal rules are Croatian - applying it
to Greece or Spain would be confidently wrong, so those
regions run structure + conditions only until someone
jurisdiction  whose fishing law applies. Closed seasons and minimum
sizes in species.json are Croatian ONLY.
enabled       whether the daily workflow computes it. Each enabled
region costs a few hundred KB of output and about 5
seconds of compute, so turn on what you use.
Bathymetry is EMODnet, which covers European seas only. Outside that
footprint the relief term has nothing to work with and the region should

regions.name: Novigrad, Istria
regions.note: The home region. Species pack, closed seasons and exclusion zones all checked here; everything else in this file inherits or omits them.

regions.name: Kvarner — Krk and Cres
regions.note: Same jurisdiction and broadly the same species as Novigrad, but deeper and rockier. NO exclusion zones are defined here yet - check protected areas yourself.

regions.name: Split and Brač channel
regions.note: Croatian rules apply, so the closed seasons hold. Clearer and deeper than Istria; the species depth bands were tuned on a shallow shelf and will read low here.

regions.name: Piran and the Gulf
regions.note: Structure and conditions only. Slovenian fishing law differs from Croatian, so the species pack is deliberately NOT applied - showing Croatian closed seasons here would be worse than showing nothing.

regions.name: Gulf of Trieste
regions.note: Italian rules. Needs its own species pack before the target view means anything.

regions.name: Costa Brava
regions.note: Different species assemblage and Spanish regional rules. Structure and conditions only.

regions.name: Sardinia, north-west
regions.note: Deep and clear. The visibility model was tuned on a turbid shelf and will understate clarity badly here.

regions.name: Corsica, west coast
regions.note: French rules, several marine reserves. Do not dive this on the app alone.

regions.name: Algarve, central
regions.note: Atlantic, not Mediterranean: real tides, real swell, and a different species list entirely.

regions.name: Paros and Naxos
regions.note: Meltemi dominates everything here; the shelter term should do more work than usual.
